content: OG detail-page minimum: og:title, og:description, og:image (+og:image:width/height/alt), og:url. Image 1200x630 (1.91:1) works cleanly across Facebook/X/LinkedIn/Discord/Slack/WhatsApp/iMessage. Use PNG/JPEG, avoid WebP/SVG (unsupported on some platforms), never below 200x200. og:type unlocks type-specific properties (article:*, product:*) that are ignored if og:type doesn't match; product/website are the realistic choices for a game detail page (schema.org handles the richer 'Game' semantics separately).
